title: Gaussian measure on an open interval
statement: For all real numbers $a$ and $b$, the standard Gaussian measure of the open interval $(a,b)$ equals the integral of its density over that interval: $\gamma((a,b))=\int_{(a,b)}\varphi(x)\,dx$, where $\varphi$ is the standard Gaussian density.
